reason: The original Windows broadcast held 16 notifications and its ordinary stream silently discarded Lagged errors. A stopped recording receiver must not hide missing original payload.
changes: Windows callback queue holds 512 bounded notifications
Windows callback preserves monotonic receive time before queueing
checked_notifications exposes native lag to the recording durable-offset retry
Existing Peripheral notifications trait stays compatible and no device/subscription/connection is added
limits: The ordinary trait keeps its upstream error semantics for existing callers. Recording uses the checked extension. Queue capacity is finite; overload is a receive failure, never successful consumption.
validation: Companion .cache/stopped-upload-20261009/r17/native-queue-harness compiles the exact production util source with three burst/overflow/timestamp checks, avoiding unrelated upstream example dev dependencies. Product pull_receiver tests cover propagation, bounds, timing and cancellation.
license: LICENSE.md is copied unchanged; original package file hashes are retained in UPSTREAM.json.
